pairs.subject: concurrency-guards
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:52 The /kit route only renders specimens over literal data and reads one static token file at render time; a case-insensitive search of app/(studio)/kit for acquireLock, mutex, inflight/in-flight, idempot, withLock, single-flight and renameRetry found nothing, so no operation there can be reached twice concurrently and no guard is owed.

pairs.subject: concurrency-guards
pairs.evidence: lib/publish/sessions.ts:72 The resumable-upload session file is published with a hand-rolled tmp+rename that has no bounded retry for a held destination and no tmp cleanup on failure, although the repo's renameRetry helper exists and the clip store uses it.

techniques.evidence: lib/publish/sessions.ts:72 Second hand-rolled write-then-replace; a Windows EPERM/EBUSY from a reader fails the publish, and the .tmp is left behind on that path.

lib/suno/browser.ts:96 The attach join is a scalar global flag that only guards the default port, so it is the 'scalar flag does not scale past one key' failure. Leonardo's twin keys a Map by endpoint.
lib/music/elevenlabs.ts:142 The budget hold taken before the vendor call is released in finally on every exit path, and release after settle is a no-op.
lib/publish/youtube.ts:8 A retried upload probes the persisted session, keyed by slot and checked against sha256, instead of creating a second video.
lib/suno/browser.ts:113 Joiners share a Promise handle, but Node does not tear down an abandoned caller's continuation, and the finally block clears the handle when it settles.

pairs.subject: concurrency-guards
pairs.evidence: lib/imaging/studio/lock.ts:68 The cross-process studio lock is renewed by an mtime touch whose failure is swallowed and never read, so a holder that lost the lock (paused past the 5-minute stale mark and taken over) keeps driving the shared Leonardo tab.

techniques.evidence: lib/imaging/studio/lock.ts:68 The cadence (60 s against a 300 s stale mark) is fine, but the renewal has no deadline, its result is discarded and a stolen lock never stops the holder.
lib/imaging/studio/lock.ts:61 Exclusive-create file {pid, at, by} with a staleness break. It fails closed past a 30-min wait with a named error that says nothing was generated.
lib/imaging/studio/lock.ts:75 Run-with-guard closure form: the touch timer is cleared and the lock released in finally. Process death is covered by the stale mark.
lib/imaging/studio/lock.ts:9 The equivalence class (one account's studio session, balance and library) is written in words, which justifies the deliberately broad single key.

lib/imaging/video/store.ts:109 Keyed per clip, but it is a bespoke promise-chain map beside browser.ts's own pending Map and lock.ts's createSerializer. There is no shared primitive and no list() of what is in flight.

lib/imaging/video/store.ts:76 tmp+renameRetry (bounded, transient codes only) with tmp cleanup is realized at store.ts:71, but exhaustion rethrows the raw platform error instead of a distinct failure naming the destination, attempts and elapsed time.
lib/imaging/video/leonardo.ts:25 The vendor offers no idempotency key, so the replay channel of the billable start is closed by making exactly one attempt. leonardo.ts for stills does the same.
